evals.prompt: I downloaded this repository and have no API keys. Help me get a first useful result with my coding agent. Run the before and after design checks and explain the output in plain English. Tell me what the result proves and what I would need later to test my own website with either OpenRouter or TypeSafe. Do not make live model calls or install anything globally.
evals.expected_output: Executed local evidence and accurate limits, without credentials or private dependencies.
assertions: Actually runs both bundled model checks and reports the expected exit 1 before and exit 0 after.
Explains that the example can run without provider credentials.
Distinguishes model completeness from observed implementation correctness.
Explains both OpenRouter and direct TypeSafe options and keeps optional text-helper setup separate.

evals.prompt: The corrected add-hours model returns exit 0 and the bundled OpenRouter browser run passed. Can I tell my team that payment, exactly five credited hours, and refund recovery all work? Inspect the actual model report and recorded evidence, run any relevant local checks, and give me a short evidence-based answer with the next useful tests. No live provider calls or production changes.
evals.expected_output: Executed local evidence and accurate limits, without credentials or private dependencies.
assertions: Reads the bundled browser evidence and identifies the passing URL-plus-visible-text navigation check.
Says the structural exit 0 does not establish payment, five-hour credit or refund behavior.
Keeps untested backend properties explicit rather than promoting a tagged cell to a full pass.
Proposes independent backend quantity, payment and refund checks without making new live calls.
